summary: Frontend retest of the 2 HIGH draft-autosave bugs from iteration_77 in ReservaManual.tsx (property A161, user qa_varela). Both are FIXED. BUG 1: picked 2026-12-01→03 in the calendar, clicked 'Reservar estas fechas' and changed nothing. The total filled in by itself (52500). Closing with X wrote nothing to localStorage. Reopening with 'Reserva manual' showed a clean form (dates, total and name empty) and no rt-manual-draft-restored notice. BUG 2: saved a draft (name TEST_Retest Draft, 12-01→12-03), closed with X, then picked 12-10→12-12 in the calendar and clicked 'Reservar estas fechas'. The modal shows the NEW dates 2026-12-10 / 2026-12-12, keeps the name and shows the notice, and the draft in storage now holds the new dates. Regression: the restore notice appears after closing with X; Cancelar removes the key and the next open is clean; the 3 validation messages are correct (nombre, then fechas, then monto); typing the first character saves the draft without showing the notice; Crear reserva works (POST 201, the modal closes, the draft is removed and the next open is clean).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor, design choice: after Bug 2's date override, montoTotal is reset to '' and the quote fills it again. Because totalTocado=false, an amount the user had typed in the old draft is dropped on purpose. That is reasonable because the dates changed.

Minor: when the calendar dates override a draft, the notice still says 'Recuperamos lo que estabas completando…' even though the dates are new. This is acceptable because the guest data really was restored.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (2/2 bug retests + regression of draft restore/cancel/validations/create)
